title: Fix NaN timestamp bypass in DAO backbone replay protection
description: The receive_from_peer() function in multi_instance.rs has a security vulnerability where NaN timestamps bypass the freshness validation check. At line 651, the comparison 'age > DAO_TIMESTAMP_FRESHNESS_SECONDS || age < 0.0' silently passes when age is NaN because NaN comparisons always return false. An attacker could craft a DaoBackboneMessage with timestamp=f64::NAN to bypass replay protection. Fix by adding explicit NaN check: 'if age.is_nan() || age > DAO_TIMESTAMP_FRESHNESS_SECONDS || age < 0.0'
close_reason: Fixed: Added explicit age.is_nan() check in receive_from_peer() timestamp validation to prevent NaN bypass of replay protection
